overview: The Medford Licensing Commission approved a license category change to an all-alcohol license for Naya Japanese Restaurant, four one-day event licenses for Event Them Studios, and the commission's 2023 annual report.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the December 20, 2023 meeting.

items.title: Change of License Category: Naya Japanese Restaurant
items.summary: Approved an application by Naya Sky Inc., doing business as Naya Japanese Restaurant at 9 High Street, to change its license category from wine and malt to all-alcohol, subject to state approval.

items.title: One-Day Special Licenses: Event Them Studios
items.summary: Approved four one-day liquor licenses for upcoming events at Event Them Studios located at 344 Salem Street.

items.title: 2023 Annual Report and Quota Discussion
items.summary: Approved the 2023 annual report and discussed population quota metrics regarding the potential availability of an additional package store license.
